claims: The Artemis II Orion capsule reaches a maximum speed of approximately 25,000 mph (40,000 km/h) during its reentry into Earth's atmosphere.
Artemis 2 maximum velocity is reached just before entry interface.
Artemis 2 Trans-Lunar Injection speed is ~24,527 mph (39,472 km/h).
Artemis 2 parachute deployment slows capsule to ~300 mph, then 17 mph for landing.
Artemis 2 mid-space cruise speed is ~17,000 mph.
